environment: Desktop Chromium (headless, drawing in software), each phone size at 2x pixels (memory also at 3x); the preview bundled by Vite and served with the production headers below. The CPU slowdown is Chromium's throttle of the page's main thread, a rough stand-in for a slower phone. Not a phone, not Safari: no phone's frame rate or memory was measured.

sharpness: with its pictures drawn, frames slower than the screen take the frame down one step, and frames that keep up leave it there

motion: between two paints the scene draws frames of its own

motion: when the paints stop, the scene stops by itself
lifecycle: suspended, a paint draws its frame and the scene asks for none
lifecycle: resumed, the next paint restarts its frames
time: at the end the scene asks for no more frames, and tells no one
lifecycle: dispose() removes the film and gives its memory back
lifecycle: after dispose() a paint does nothing
roster: 7, 8 and 9 members; fewer or more is refused
